author: bardic-inspiration
name: Chasmweaver Spider
summary: A huge chasm spider that strings lines across bottomless drops and reels prey in by a single sticky thread.
description: Chasmweavers live where caverns split open into depths no rope can reach. Their lines stretch from wall to wall like the rigging of a ship, and anything that falls into them hangs there over nothing. Travelers who must cross a chasm look first for the glint of old silk, and cross somewhere else.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.text: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The spider makes one Bite attack and one Dragline attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.onHit: and the target has the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Dragline
actions.onHit: The target is pulled up to 25 feet straight toward the spider. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc:dex}).
